Duties include but are not limited to: Manages the VTP Program at the facility and VTS Drivers/Motor Vehicle Operators provide safe and reliable transportation to Veterans who require assistance traveling to and from VA health care facilities and authorized non-VA health care appointments within the Medical Center's catchment area.

Manages demand against available resources to increase access to medical care through the Medical Centers organic transportation resources. VTS also collaborates with service providers in local communities to serve Veterans' transportation needs.

VTS works with a network of transportation options for Veterans through joint efforts with VA's Office of Rural Health and organizations, such as Veterans Service Organizations (VSOs) community transportation providers; federal, state and local government transportation agencies; non-profits and Veterans Transportation Community Living Initiative (VTCLI) grantees.

The Mobility Manager is the local administrator of the Vet Ride System and is responsible of granting certain delegated access rights to facility staff. Orchestrates travel for the Medical Centers BT eligible enrollees through mileage reimbursement and contracted travel modes.

The staff adjudicates mileage, lodging, meals, common carrier, SMT reimbursement requests, determines eligibility and processes payments for eligible Veterans in support of costs incurred while traveling to and from VA health care facilities. The BT program also administers all BT transportation related contracts.

The program may also provide pre-approved transportation solutions and arrange SMT at the request of VA.

The incumbent manages the Medical Center's Veterans Transportation Program services under the AD within the VAMC by planning, developing, evaluating, marketing and directing key administrative activities in multiple programs related to transportation system for Veterans, active duty servicemembers, Caregivers and others in metropolitan and rural/remote rural areas, especially those which are disabled, frail, elderly or receiving life dependent treatments (dialysis, chemo therapy, radiation therapy, etc.).

Incumbent works closely and routinely with other services within the Medical Center, including, but not limited to: Business Office (HAS); Fleet Management; Medicine Service; Social Work Service; Nursing; Voluntary Service; Primary Care, Mental Health, Homeless and Rehabilitation.

The Mobility Manager is directly responsible for completing the Needs, Resources and Stakeholders Assessment in collaboration with the other services represented on the VTP Board of Directors, as well as Veterans and community stakeholders.

Additionally the Mobility Manager will utilized the Needs, Resources and Stakeholders Assessment to develop a Three Year Developmental Business Plan for submission to the VTP Board of Directors and the VTP Program Office in order to obtain funding for the program once the Business Plan is approved by the Program Office.

Also, the Mobility Manager is responsible for managing the appropriate utilization of the Vet Ride System, including all the Administrative Portal, the web based Veteran Trip Request Portal, the Third Party Contractor Portal and the Special Mode Tracker Module, ensuring all security and compliance measures are complied with by all staff the Mobility Manager authorizes to use the system.

Time-In-Grade Requirement: Applicants who are current Federal employees and have held a GS grade any time in the past 52 weeks must also meet time-in-grade requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

For a GS-11 position you must have served 52 weeks at the GS-09. The grade may have been in any occupation, but must have been held in the Federal service. An SF-50 that shows your time-in-grade eligibility must be submitted with your application materials.

If the most recent SF-50 has an effective date within the past year, it may not clearly demonstrate you possess one-year time-in-grade, as required by the announcement. In this instance, you must provide an additional SF-50 that clearly demonstrates one-year time-in-grade.

Note: Time-In-Grade requirements also apply to former Federal employees applying for reinstatement as well as current employees applying for Veterans Employment Opportunities Act of 1998 (VEOA) appointment. The Occupational Series 2101 includes an Individual Occupational Requirement (IOR).

Candidates may not hold a position in this series without meeting the IOR requirements established by OPM.

Undergraduate and Graduate Education: Major study -- accounting, business administration, business or commercial law, commerce, economics, engineering, finance, industrial management, statistics, traffic management, transportation, motor mechanics, or other fields related to the position.

(MUST UPLOAD TRANSCRIPTS) You may qualify based on your experience as described below: Specialized Experience: (In addition to meeting time and grade and IOR) you must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade GS-09 in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization.

Examples of specialized experience would typically include, but are not limited to: fleet management and/or common carrier transportation; planning and directing administrative activities related to transportation; prioritizing program resource when conflicts arise; analyzing and evaluating information pertinent to the efficient and effective operation of a transportation program; and providing leadership/supervision, instruction/counsel to employees.

NOTE: Experience must be fully documented on your resume and must include job title, duties, month and year start/end dates AND hours worked per week.

OR, Education: A Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree or 3 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to such a degree or LL.M., if related with a Major study of: accounting, business administration, business or commercial law, commerce, economics, engineering, finance, industrial management, statistics, traffic management, transportation, motor mechanics, or other fields related to the position.(MUST UPLOAD TRANSCRIPTS).

OR, Combination: Applicants may also combine education and experience to qualify at this level. You must have an combination of specialized experience and education as listed above.

You will be rated on the following Competencies for this position: Customer Service Financial Management Planning and Evaluating Problem Solving Technical Competence Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religions; spiritual; community; student; social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. Note: A full year of work is considered to be 35-40 hours of work per week.

Part-time experience will be credited on the basis of time actually spent in appropriate activities. Applicants wishing to receive credit for such experience must indicate clearly the nature of their duties and responsibilities in each position and the number of hours a week spent in such employment.

Physical Requirements: Work is typically performed in an adequately lighted and climate-controlled office within a VA Medical Center.

For more information on these qualification standards, please visit the United States Office of Personnel Management's website at https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/.

ABSTRACT We are seeking an experienced associate transport planner to lead and grow our small transport planning team with a passion for transport and a strong track record in business development, to join our City Science team.

Experience in any of l ocal transport plans, active travel, electric vehicles, transport decarbonisation, public transport and policy development are a plus .

Many Thanks, Karl Jarvis (Head of Transport) ABOUT US: CITY SCIENCE ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a Associate level Transport Planner to lead and grow our transport planning team, with specialist experience in scoping, managing and delivering transport planning activities, as well as the communication skills to represent City Science in front of clients.

The successful candidate will oversee detailed whole-system transport planning, maximising the value of our cutting-edge research, and develop new innovations to support continued growth in business capability.

They will take an active leadership role in projects, delivering technical insights to clients through an open, trusted and consultative approach.

They will take a key role in the growth of our business, through delivering upon our team’s wider commercial targets; such as through identifying future opportunities and delivering high quality tender responses.

They will be provided the opportunity to attend, present and represent City Science at key industry wide transport and decarbonisation-focused national conferences. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:As an Associate within our City Science team you will be responsible for:
Technical oversight and leading the transport planning service line
Business development and the winning of new work
Growing the transport planning team and offer
Responsible for quality assurance on projects/technical deliverables.
Ensure timely delivery of projects within budget.
Leading engagement sessions, content development and outreach (as required).
This will include: Project Delivery & Management
Leading oversight, project management and direction, technical support and strategic direction for technical projects.
Successfully overseeing the quality delivery of projects to client expectations and technical best-practice, with clear allocation of tasks and monitoring of resources, securing positive client testimonials, including supporting other staff.
Technical
Preparing technical and client reports and presentations
Working closely with our data science and software development teams to automate processes and provide constructive feedback to ensure continuous improvement.
Managing and providing technical oversight, advisory and analysis on a range of transport and net zero projects
Undertaking technical research and prototyping to test and automate transport planning processes.
Developing and delivering expert transport and sustainability advice, analysis and thought leadership.
Communication & Stakeholder Engagement
Responsible for leading, conducting, overseeing and delivering high-quality reports, action plans, expert advice, informative graphics and compelling visualisations.
Facilitating stakeholder engagement during projects including oversight of preparation of material.
Meeting and presenting our capability to key stakeholders including senior officers and portfolio holders within local authorities.
Representing detailed technical information to potential clients clearly, honestly and with integrity.
Business Development
Taking responsibility for work winning – taking the role of Bid Manager on medium to large tenders and tracking emerging opportunities, as well as leading negotiations where applicable
Develop the highest level client relationships and market knowledge
Accountable for revenue and win work targets
Raise our profile, including promoting our offer to clients and leading promotional campaigns.
Providing clients with a deep understanding of our solutions, services and emerging innovations.
Lead and actively support company-wide win work initiatives
Team Leadership
Leading and delivering elements of service and regional business plans.
Undertaking management responsibilities including team and line management, staff resourcing, staff development, mentoring and coordinating social activities.
Upskilling our team and systems to enhance technical skills and levels of quality.
Line management, development and mentoring of our team members, specialising in transport planning and sustainability. Overseeing multiple sectors of our Transport and Net Zero offer. Requirements ABOUT YOU You’re ambitious, proactive and customer-focused with exceptional attention to detail and the needs of our clients.

You’re a champion and expert in your field with a rigorous, disciplined approach and a deep technical knowledge of transport planning and sustainability. You have extensive experience working within transport systems and are comfortable working with and leading technical elements of projects.

You’re a great collaborator, committed to success of the team with the flexibility to intelligently adapt your style to the task in hand. Most importantly, you’ve got the drive, ambition, hunger and work ethic to succeed in this fast-moving role.

You will have a track record in business development and an extensive client relationship network to draw upon. City Science is a growth-focused organisation with an expanding team and so an entrepreneurial, resilient and tenacious mindset are critical. ESSENTIAL Project Management & Delivery
Proven track record in managing successful delivery of complex projects and programmes as Project Manager or Technical Advisor, in accordance with management systems and governance.
Strong report writing skills with the ability to produce clear, precise and coherent analyses (e.g. business cases, briefing papers and technical reports) for a range of technical and non-technical audiences, including reviewing work of others, to achieve consistency.
Strong analytical skills with a comprehensive understanding of industry trends and issues.
Ability to work independently when required and effectively delegate to remote teams and review project tasks, including a track record of delivering projects to time and budget constraints.
Good appreciation of project risk issues and application of these to day-to-day tasks.
Experience delivering transport, sustainability and/or decarbonisation strategies.
Experience with advising on Local Transport Plans.
Experience with delivering Local Cycling & Walking Infrastructure Plans.
Technical Knowledge
10 years plus of relevant work experience, with at least 4 years experience in a commercial role

Mentor junior staff and provide guidance on project management.

Develop and maintain routing strategies and lead-time management in ERP systems (e.g., SAP).
Work closely with Clinical Supply Planning, Master Planning, Clinical Operations, Logistics, Trade Compliance, and external partners.

Bachelor's Degree Degree in a science or business function or equivalent experience.
2-3+ Years related industry experience in Clinical Trials or Pharmacy (preferred).

Ability to create effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Ability to demonstrate effective communication and direction.
Ability to problem solve.
Good Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel, Powerpoint etc).
Proficient in the English language.

Jumia is a leading pan-African e-commerce platform. Its mission is to improve the quality of everyday life in Africa by leveraging technology to deliver innovative, convenient and affordable online services to customers, while helping businesses grow as they use Jumia's platform to better reach and serve customers.
Jumia is built around a marketplace and supported by a proprietary logistics business [Jumia Logistics] and a digital payment and fintech platform [Jumia Pay] . With over 3,000 employees, Jumia is led by top talented leaders offering a great mix of local and international talents and is backed by very high-profile shareholders. Jumia is committed to creating a sustainable impact in Africa.
In April 2019, Jumia was the first Tech company in Africa to be listed on the New York Stock Exchange.

The Transport Planner is responsible for route planning, schedule management, and load optimization within Jumia's logistics network, working closely with dispatch, warehouse, and 3PL teams to ensure efficient, cost-effective, and on-time movement of shipments.
What You Will Be Doing
Plan and optimize daily transport routes and vehicle allocation to maximize fleet efficiency and minimize delays.
Utilize Jumia's logistics systems (e.g., TMS) to create and adjust dynamic routes, aligning with real-time demand, traffic conditions, and delivery SLAs.
Publish daily and weekly capacity plans based on shipment volume and size mix (small/medium/bulky).
Coordinate pickup and delivery schedules with dispatch teams, warehouse operations, and third-party logistics partners.
Track key metrics such as on-time delivery rates, fuel efficiency, vehicle utilization, and route adherence; recommend adjustments based on data trends.
Support cost-saving initiatives by identifying inefficiencies in routing and load planning.
Assist in resolving scheduling conflicts, exceptions, and delivery escalations in coordination with dispatch and customer service teams.
Maintain accurate planning records and prepare regular reports on route performance, capacity utilization, and plan adherence for management review.
Collaborate with warehouse and network teams to align transport plans with inbound and outbound volume projections.

Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Operations, or a related field preferred.
Experience in logistics, transportation planning, or dispatch operations.
Proficiency in Transport Management Systems (TMS), route optimization software, and Excel/data analysis tools.
Strong analytical and data-driven approach to problem-solving, with experience in KPI tracking and route performance analysis.
Understanding of supply chain operations, last-mile delivery challenges, and e-commerce logistics requirements.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple planning priorities simultaneously.
Good communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across dispatch, warehouse, and 3PL stakeholders.

A unique experience in an entrepreneurial, yet structured environment
A unique opportunity of having strong impact in building the African e-commerce sector
The opportunity to become part of a highly professional and dynamic team
An unparalleled personal and professional growth as our longer-term objective is to train the next generation of leaders

You will serve as the Brigade strategic mobility and exercise planner working for the Deputy S3 for operations.
You will be responsible for coordinating and preparing contingency plans for strategic deployment, Reception, Staging and Onward movement (RSO) of US Forces throughout their AOR.
You will coordinate directly with joint and theater service staffs on initiating, developing and maintaining mobilization, emergency and contingency plans in their AOR and coordinate planning for strategic sealift movement in support of exercises.
You will review all OPLANS to ensure mission capability and analyze SDDC and TEA (Transportation Engineering Agency) port capability studies to ensure realistic contingency plans are developed and integrated into wartime planning.
You will direct the Transportation Brigade contingency planning and manage and coordinate short and long range planning policies and procedures.
You will provide guidance and assistance to subordinates' activities concerning mobilization and contingency operations, as well as being the command's Point of Contact (POC) on contingency issues with HQ SDDC.
You will use the transportation aspects of the Global Command and Control System (GCCS) and Joint Operations, Planning and Execution System (JOPES) to direct and integrate products into the Brigade supporting planning efforts.
